title: TRC: TeleportCompasses
description: A simple paper plugin that adds a compass with the ability to teleport to a set location.
body: This plugin adds a crafting recipe for a special compass that allows players to teleport directly to the lodestone it is bound to. The compass is crafted using an Echo Shard, an Ender Pearl, and a Bound Compass. The maximum number of uses for the compass can be configured in the config file.
